description: Why a delivery attempt failed, and what should happen next. Seeded create-only by jarz_pos.setup.courier_setup; a failure never changes the invoice board state, it only sets this reason and increments the attempt counter.

fields.description: Stable machine key. This is also the document name, so it is what Sales Invoice.custom_delivery_failure_reason stores — renaming one orphans every invoice that pointed at it.
fields.label: Code

fields.description: Shown to couriers. The courier app is Arabic-first, so this is the string most users actually read.
fields.label: Label (Arabic)

fields.description: What dispatch should do with the order after this failure. Advisory: this app does not act on it automatically, because Return and Cancel both have accounting consequences that belong to the existing return / cancellation workflows.
fields.label: Next Action

fields.description: Inactive reasons stay linked on historical invoices but are hidden from the courier's picker.
fields.label: Is Active

name: Delivery Failure Reason
